findings.purpose: Phase date fields record major changes to settlements. Farmstead and villa labels may describe successive phases, rather than contemporaneous institutions.
Occupation chronologies vary in precision and can contain hiatuses; complete endpoints alone do not prove continuity.

findings.purpose: Palimpsests and limited investigated areas can obscure separate developmental phases; morphology is not a direct functional timeline.
